title: Voidheart Lock
description: No darkness. No death. Lock at ½ heart. Survive the void.
body:
### ✨ Voidheart Lock

> *“Darkness never blinds you. Death never claims you.”*

**Voidheart Lock** is a Fabric mod for Minecraft **1.21.11** that removes the Warden's darkness effect and grants you a second chance when facing lethal damage.

### ⚔️ Features

- 🌑 **Darkness Immunity** – The Warden's blindness effect is completely removed.
- ❤️ **Death Lock** – When taking fatal damage (including void or `/kill`), your health locks to ½ heart.
- 🛡️ **Invincibility** – During lock, you take no damage until you start regenerating naturally.
- 💀 **Void Protection** – Falling into the void won’t kill you; health remains at 1 point.

### 📦 Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API
- **Must be installed on both client and server** (darkness removal works client-side, death lock works server-side).

### 🎯 Perfect for

Players who want a fair second chance without losing the thrill of survival.
